expectations.evidence: Section 1 lists 6 capabilities in active use: L7 content switching, SSL/TLS offloading, GSLB, WAF/AppFW, health monitoring, and K8s ingress (CPX). Includes deployment scale (30 vservers, 4 HA pairs, 2 DCs).

Section 2.1 capability mapping table explicitly compares iRules+Local Traffic Policies vs content switching, ASM/Advanced WAF vs AppFW (noting ASM more mature), BIG-IP DNS/GTM vs GSLB. Full parity noted for all.
Section 2.2 capability mapping table details what Octavia/HAProxy can replace (L7 policies partial, SSL full) and cannot (GSLB: none, WAF: none, health monitoring: partial, ACI service graph: poor).
Section 2.2 GSLB Gap lists 4 options: PowerDNS with Lua/dnsdist, NS1 SaaS, Consul+DNS, or keep NetScaler for GSLB only. F5 BIG-IP DNS/GTM covered as the recommended full-parity option.
Section 2.2 WAF Gap lists ModSecurity+NGINX, Coraza WAF, and commercial WAF options. F5 ASM covered in section 2.1 as full OWASP coverage. Assessment notes added complexity of separate WAF layer.

F5 CIS described in section 2.1 table and Phase 4 migration plan. Also mentions F5 NGINX Ingress Controller option. HAProxy K8s IC noted as separate from Octavia. Phase 4 details CIS vs NGINX IC evaluation.

Section 8 details F5 device package integration (6 steps), hybrid model recommendation. Section 2.2 explains Octavia has no ACI device package. Device package import, L4-L7 device cluster creation, GoTo/GoThrough modes all covered.

5-phase plan: Phase 0 foundation (weeks 1-4), Phase 1 non-prod (5-8), Phase 2 production in 3 batches of 10 services (9-14), Phase 3 GSLB (12-16), Phase 4 K8s ingress (14-18), Phase 5 decommission (18-22). Rollback plan included.
Section 2.2 covers Octavia architecture (amphorae, lifecycle management, HA pairs), Barbican for certs, Terraform/Ansible/Heat support, and detailed ACI integration limitations with workarounds.

All three options have licensing/cost tables. F5: $350-450K/yr, 3-yr $1.0-1.35M. Octavia: $100-200K/yr with hidden GSLB/WAF costs. NetScaler: $150-300K/yr. Includes labor, engineering effort, and support costs.

NITRO API documented under NetScaler. F5 automation covered: AS3 declarative API, Terraform provider, Ansible 150+ modules, FAST templates, Telemetry Streaming. Section 7 shows full CI/CD workflow with Git+Terraform+AS3 pipeline.

Section 4 recommends F5 BIG-IP VE with 5 explicit rationale points: feature completeness, ACI integration, automation maturity, vendor stability, migration path clarity. Also states when to choose Octavia or stay on NetScaler.
